Lena Cho: Quick sync 1 CobaltEdge preview: NDA signed, partner requested a short validation window (48h) to verify perf and a marketplace blurb. Need bench volunteers and a security checkpoint.
Marcus Flynn: I can run the bench profile. Hardware is Cobalt V2 (tensor cores), driver is cuda-12.5 per partner note. We'll test 13B fp16 and 6B int8.
Yusuf Ahmed: I'll prepare the prompt suites (convo + code + long-context). Will include seed lists for deterministic runs.
Priya Shah: Bench harness requirements? Will we use our standard bench-run tool or a pared-down script for the isolated lab?
Marcus Flynn: Use bench-run-lite inside the partner sandbox, command like:
./bench-lite --model cobalt-13b --prec fp16 --batch 8 --seq 2048 --iters 120 --telemetry https://telemetry.redwood.ai/ingest
Lena Cho: Security: partner insists on no raw request bodies leaving their VLAN. Legal has redlined telemetry terms.
LegalBot: Telemetry accepted with hashed traces and 30-day retention. Partner signed deletion SLA for raw payloads.
Yusuf Ahmed: Metrics to collect: tokens/s, p95 latency, GPU mem high-water, kernel fallbacks count, and output similarity vs our baseline. I'll add divergence check.
infra-bot: network: please whitelist 18.209.34.77 for telemetry. Temporary egress rule will be created for the run window.
Marcus Flynn: Image pushed: redwood-runtime:cobalt-eap-20260405-rc1. Will toggle fused kernels if needed.
Priya Shah: Prompt sets uploaded to /shared/partnerships/cobalt/2026-04. Running warmup now.
Lena Cho: Schedule: Tue AM infra + image, Tue PM bench 13B, Wed AM bench 6B + stability. Quick pre-run check Wed 8:30am PT. Drop confirmations here when done.
